images.author: Austin Madinga
images.why: Otter Point at Cape Maclear: characteristic granite boulders, green water and wooded shoreline. Strong location match; original dimensions unconfirmed.

images.author: Ben / Travels with Ben
images.why: Smooth shoreline boulders at Otter Point during sunset; warm colour and a useful foreground for a near-square crop. Original dimensions unconfirmed.

images.author: unknown
images.why: Classic national-park view with sunlit granite rocks, turquoise water and distant hills. Fallback: 1920×700, below the preferred resolution and requiring a substantial crop.

images.author: Igor Tverdovskiy
images.why: Explicitly located at Issyk-Kul, with broad water, mountain backdrop and blue-sky colouring. Canon EOS M50 photograph; strongest freely licensed match.

images.author: Nizar F
images.why: 7728×5152 Fujifilm photograph of Issyk-Kul with distant mountains and an uncluttered evening sky. Ample cropping room; subtler colour than the daytime option.

images.author: J. Hipfner (credited in filename)
images.why: Official tourism photograph explicitly identifying Thaidene Nëné on Great Slave Lake’s East Arm. Strong wilderness setting; exact dimensions unconfirmed.

images.author: J. Hipfner (credited in filename)
images.why: Dramatic East Arm cliffs above calm water, with warm rock colour and soft evening light. Distinctive shoreline detail for a tight poster crop; dimensions unconfirmed.

images.author: Pat Kane
images.why: Aerial East Arm view showing turquoise coves, forested islands and rocky cliffs. Excellent geographic context; linked rendition’s dimensions unconfirmed.

images.author: Vinicius Dattwyler
images.why: 3245×2163 landscape photograph showing Perito Moreno extending into turquoise lake water with mountains behind. Strong combination of lake, ice wall and setting.

images.author: Hans-Jürgen Weinhardt
images.why: Location-confirmed Perito Moreno photograph with blue ice and mountainous surroundings. Fujifilm X-E3 capture; useful alternative glacier composition.

images.author: Jose Luis Vanasco
images.why: 6192×4125 Nikon D850 photograph of Perito Moreno’s icy blue formations and surrounding mountains. High resolution provides considerable freedom for a 9:10 crop.

images.author: Pete Alexopoulos
images.why: Deep-blue Crater Lake with Wizard Island explicitly described near the centre, making it a promising 9:10 crop. Nikon D600 photograph.

images.author: Rich Martello
images.why: Scenic lake-and-island composition explicitly located in Crater Lake National Park, Oregon. Strong blue palette; Sony RX100 VII photograph.

images.author: Kaixin Wang
images.why: Crater Lake and its volcanic island provide a recognisable focal point against blue water. Location-confirmed Sony a6700 photograph.
